# A cannonball: a dark rock ball 0.26 m across, origin at its centre. make_env.py.
new
material new Iron --base-color 0.4353 0.4039 0.4627 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1300 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 0.0000 0.0000
material assign Iron
select all
shade flat
export ball.glb
